body: Everyone sells gold. Nobody lets you use it. Wealthsimple and OneGold park it in a vault. Coinbase and Nexo lend cash — but only against crypto. Auri is the one place real gold is your savings and your collateral at once: non-custodial, borrow at 3.75%. Gold can fall; loans can liquidate.
